positions.name: CalibrationStatusRecord
positions.frame: what does this record establish as the current, verified calibration status of the Kestrelwood spectrograph — and how do its narrative and structured renderings relate to that status?
positions.why: All three expressions converge on the same underlying fact — Kestrelwood's calibration at 88.4 MHz, verified against the June reference plates — rendered first as prose (src-1) and then restated as structured field entries (src-2, src-3). The register pass groups all three under the same flat-technical-instrument signature (technical, matter-of-fact, no audience-directed performance), and affect/value reads are uniform calm-positive/competence across the set, supporting a single directional read. There is a mild tension the frame holds rather than resolves: conviction reads src-1 and src-2 as flat claim-level assertions while src-3 tips toward decision-level (a performed, already-completed verification act) — the group carries both the assertion that calibration holds and the record that it was formally settled, without forcing them into one voice.
